name: Throne of Command (Major Artifact)
body:
Aura strong divination and enchantment; CL 20th; Slot none; Price —; Weight 3,475 lbs.

STATISTICS

Alignment LE; Ego 10; Senses 30 ft.; Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 10; Communication empathy; Powers at will – detect evil, detect good, discern lies (DC 16)
3/day – dismissal (DC 17), greater command (DC 17)
1/day – planar binding (DC 19)

DESCRIPTION

Great horns of gold, a massive sea serpent’s skull, and the wings of Kazavon form the ornate Throne of Command. The throne grants whoever is seated upon it a +6 enhancement bonus to Charisma and Wisdom. Once per day, the user can cast geas/quest. Any creature with the evil subtype takes a –6 penalty on saving throws to resist this effect.

DESTRUCTION

The Throne of Command crumbles to dust if a person who wants nothing sits upon it and bequeaths all he has to another.
